AgentMemory.description: What an agent's memory reads, beside the store.

sources.description:
The sources it searches, as `plugin.name`. Empty means none, so a
narrow agent isn't flooded by a large lake.

ArgumentMatch.description:
What one of a call's arguments says, as a guardrail's `deny` refuses it
or its `action` picks the calls it's about.

argument.description: The argument, as a dotted path such as `operation` or `filter.kind`.

matches.description:
A pattern that ignores case. A string is matched as it is, anything
else as JSON. A call without the argument doesn't match.

Budget.description:
What one run may use. Every field is required: a run doesn't get an
unlimited anything by leaving it out. Calls are capped at 512 so a receipt
is always bounded.

max_request_bytes.description: The size of one request to a model.

max_tool_calls.description: Tool calls, including the ones refused.

max_total_tokens.description: Tokens read and written across all model calls.

max_usd_micros.description: Money, in millionths of a dollar.

Guardrail.description: A rule on one of the agent's tools.

action.description: The calls of the tool its rules are about. Left out, all of them.

because.description: Why, as the model is told when the rule stops it.

claimed.description:
The same as `required`, but only for an answer this pattern matches,
ignoring case: what the answer says the tool did, such as
`\b(saved|stored)\b`.

deny.description: Refuses a call whose argument matches.

max_calls.description: Refuses the agent's calls past this many.

name.description: Its name, unique within the agent. A call it refuses names it.

required.description: The agent must call the tool, and see it run, before it answers.

tool.description: The tool it holds to the rule: one the agent has.

Skill.description: Instructions for some tasks, added when the task matches.

instructions.description: What the agent is told when it applies.

name.description: Its name, unique within the agent.

unless.description: When it doesn't, even if `when` matches.

when.description:
When it applies: a pattern matched against the task as the agent
receives it, ignoring case.

description: A sub-agent: a chat with its own instructions and tools.

budget.description:
Its limits. The runtime's default if left out. A workflow's remaining
money and time still apply.

guardrails.description: Rules on its tools, enforced as it calls them.

max_output_tokens.description: The longest each of its replies may be.

memory.description: What its memory reads. Left out, every source the plugins offer.

skills.description: Instructions for some tasks, added when the task matches.

tools.description: The tools it may call. None is fine.

title: Agent
